Source definition: Annual operating cash flows scaled by average total assets. Because COMPUSTAT Global Industrial cash-flow data are generally unavailable, CF is computed indirectly as NI − ACC, where NI is income before extraordinary items scaled by average total assets and ACC is the balance-sheet accrual measure: change in current assets minus change in cash and cash equivalents, minus change in current liabilities, plus changes in short-term debt in current liabilities and income taxes payable, minus depreciation and amortization expense, all scaled by average total assets. If data on short-term debt or income taxes payable are missing, the changes in both variables are set to zero. Formula/construction: NI − ACC (both scaled by average total assets; ACC as defined by the balance-sheet-change formula).

variable_coverage.construction: Source definition: Raw annual accruals calculated by the balance-sheet approach: change in current assets minus change in cash and cash equivalents, minus change in current liabilities, plus changes in short-term debt in current liabilities and income taxes payable, minus depreciation and amortization expense; scaled by average total assets. If data on short-term debt or income taxes payable are missing, the changes in both variables are set to zero. Formula/construction: (ΔCurrent assets − ΔCash − ΔCurrent liabilities + ΔShort-term debt in current liabilities + ΔIncome taxes payable − Depreciation and amortization) / average total assets.

Source definition: Indicator equal to one for firms domiciled in countries requiring IFRS adoption in 2005 and zero for benchmark firms. Formula/construction: 1 for mandatory IFRS adopter; 0 for benchmark firm.
Source definition: Indicator equal to one for fiscal years in 2006–2007 and zero otherwise; 2005 is omitted. Formula/construction: 1 for fiscal years ending after 05/31/2005 (2006–2007); 0 otherwise.
Source definition: Interaction of the post-adoption indicator and the mandatory-IFRS indicator. Formula/construction: Post × IFRS.

Source definition: Change in total revenue less change in accounts receivable, each deflated by average total assets. Formula/construction: (ΔRevenue / average total assets) - (ΔAccounts receivable / average total assets).
Source definition: Gross property, plant and equipment deflated by average total assets. Formula/construction: gross PPE / average total assets.
Source definition: Inverse of fiscal-year-end total assets in U.S. dollars; Table 3 reports Assets in U.S. dollars millions. Formula/construction: 1 / fiscal-year-end total assets (U.S.$ millions).
Source definition: Book value of equity divided by market value of equity. Formula/construction: book equity / market equity.
Source definition: Percentage change in sales. Formula/construction: percentage change in sales.
Source definition: Percentage change in common stock outstanding. Formula/construction: percentage change in common stock outstanding.
Source definition: Year-end total liabilities divided by year-end book value of equity. Formula/construction: year-end total liabilities / year-end book value of equity.
Source definition: Percentage change in total liabilities. Formula/construction: percentage change in total liabilities.
Source definition: Sales divided by end-of-year total assets. Formula/construction: sales / end-of-year total assets.
Source definition: Natural logarithm of end-of-year market value of equity. Formula/construction: ln(end-of-year market value of equity).

Source definition: Annual operating cash flows scaled by average total assets. Because COMPUSTAT Global Industrial cash-flow data are generally unavailable, CF is computed indirectly as NI − ACC, where NI is income before extraordinary items scaled by average total assets and ACC is the balance-sheet accrual measure: change in current assets minus change in cash and cash equivalents, minus change in current liabilities, plus changes in short-term debt in current liabilities and income taxes payable, minus depreciation and amortization expense, all scaled by average total assets. If data on short-term debt or income taxes payable are missing, the changes in both variables are set to zero. Formula/construction: NI − ACC (both scaled by average total assets; ACC as defined by the balance-sheet-change formula).
